rules.message: `netlify deploy --dir=dist` re-runs the netlify.toml build without your local .env; add --no-build to ship the dist/ you tested.
Some Python builds ship an empty CA store; build the SSL context from certifi when the default store has no CAs.

prompt_hints.message: for questions across projects, call the code-wiki MCP tools first (search_taxonomy find_dependents for services; search_repos for literal strings such as model ids).
